title: Fix Puzzle 3d Play Dev
description: puzzle 3d play dev server fails with Babel duplicate declaration BoardStructuralDeleteReporter in framework playground react renderer.
summary: Removed premature @puzzle/2d/react imports of BoardStructuralDeleteReporter, BoardPlayRedrawProgressReset, and BoardPaneChrome that duplicated local playground definitions and broke Vite/Babel for puzzle 3d play dev. Added @framework/playground/core vitest alias in @puzzle/3d/react so cameraStateNearEqual tests resolve play/index.ts. Dev server serves HTTP 200; all 84 @puzzle/3d/react tests pass.
